items.html:
Pakistan-born Qaiser Ali played once as an opening batsman for Rawalpindi B in 1995-96 before moving to Canada, making his debut for them as a middle-order batsman in 2004. While he has struggled to find his touch in one-day matches, he has scored heavily in the longer format of the Intercontinental Cup, making a massive 174 against Netherlands in December 2006.
Martin Williamson February 2007
